chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Screen test at Columbia for Miguelito and Olga San Juan
summary: Miguelito Valdes and Olga San Juan did a Columbia test with Machito's band; Olga made it, Miguelito didn't.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: So Miguelito Valdes got here that particular time from that he was traveling with Cugat, and there was a tryout for Miguelito Valdes and Olga San Juan. Maybe they don't like how Miguelito photographed or whatever, because they was looking
for a combination like Diosa Costelo and Desi Arnaz. Olga San Juan made it, Miguelito didn't made it.
You mean he had a screen test.
A screen test, and we played for that, for nothing. We went to Columbia, that was located 46th St., the studio was.
Is that where you made "El Bombo Arrollador", for that tropical night thing?
